name: setup
description: One-time project bootstrap: config, test users, EXECUTION-GUIDE, INDEX, DATABASE-TABLES. Trigger: /aiqa-setup or setup project

name: write-test-cases
description: Prompt 2: story file to test-case Markdown files. Trigger: /aiqa-writetestcases <story-file> or write test cases

name: execute-tests
description: Prompt 1: run one test-case file with Playwright MCP, browser visible by default. Trigger: /aiqa-executetests <test-file> or execute tests or run tests

name: fix-bug
description: Prompt 3: reproduce, fix, verify, commit one bug. Trigger: /aiqa-fixbug <bug-file> or fix bug

name: full-workflow
description: Chain write → execute → bugs → fix → summary with user confirmation between prompts. Trigger: /aiqa-fullworkflow <story-file> or full workflow
